name: @qlinter/chrome-ext
description: Chrome extension that lints and formats Qlik load scripts inline in the Qlik Sense Data Load Editor, powered by @qlinter/core.

scripts.build: tsdown && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('public', 'dist', { recursive: true })" && npm run build:styles
scripts.build:styles: tailwindcss -i src/styles/popup.css -o dist/styles/popup.css --minify && tailwindcss -i src/styles/options.css -o dist/styles/options.css --minify && tailwindcss -i src/styles/content.css -o dist/styles/content.css --minify
